This one struck a huge chord with me.

I got fat right as I was entering puberty so at the height of my "I want to date and meet cute guys and have fun!" phase, I was this dumpy, depressed teenager who stayed inside and ate six full meals a day. I asked my mom to put me on a diet, but she basically did NOTHING except take us to the gym (ineffectual as you all know). My turning point was when I got extremely sick and didn't eat properly for two straight weeks (kidney infection), which reset my appetite COMPLETELY. I went from a size 12 or so to about a size 6, then a size 2. My lowest weight was 115lbs at around 5'5-5'6. Suddenly I had a BUNCH of male attention but guess what? I still felt fat. And I hadn't really learned my lesson either. I moved to Texas, and lived with an ineffectual manchild of an SO and his fat family (he was rail thin himself), and managed to gain all of the weight back.

I got up to 160 lbs and said "that's ENOUGH" and decided to drop the weight. The SO was not pleased about this at all. He wanted to keep me unattractive, I think.

Now I'm 120lbs with a short-term summer goal of 115lbs. I have a SMOKING hot, rich, educated boyfriend (like I have to fight off other women for this man, seriously, goddamn) BUT. I still FEEL like I used to. I FEEL like I still have the body and face of a chubby teenage loser, and that if people look at me that they're only seeing flaws and the way that my mouth droops a little and that my skin isn't an even tone and the way that the skin of my arms is still flabby despite the rest of me being thin etc etc etc.

I was lucky that I didn't go up any further, but now I look at myself and see all of the things that could have been prevented. The skin on my stomach droops when I lean over, and there are spots on my hips that will never be taut and sexy. ANY semblance of a double chin in my photos and I feel like absolute shit all over again. I'm maybe a 7/10 in terms of my face, 8/10 with instagram filters, I don't have big tits (oh they also have slightly looser skin from when I was bigger, yay) and my whole self image needs a TEAM of therapists to fix.

0/10 would not fat again. I will NEVER let my children be fat.
